document.title: Shareholder's record of stock basis and debt basis in the S corporation
document.notes: No third party issues this. It is reported on Form 7203 when the shareholder reports a loss, receives a distribution, disposes of stock, or receives a loan repayment - Schedule E line 28 column (e) has a check box for exactly that. It carries no routable box.

boxes.label: Adjusted basis of the S corporation stock
Basis of loans made by the shareholder to the S corporation
Losses and deductions not allowed by the basis limitation, carried forward

extraction.note: A taxpayer's own record. No prescribed layout, so no structured model; read generically. Nothing routes out of it, so no figure depends on that read; W20 counts it as named-and-nothing-else.
